answer_1.quote: Image captioning has been a key topic in visionlanguage research, offering a controlled setting to study grounded language generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate SPECS in the context of a wide range of metrics from different categories: rule-based, representational similarity-based and LLM-based ones. Table summarizes the results in terms of four standard correlation metrics: Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC), coefficient of determination (R 2 ), Kendall's τ (Kd τ ), and Sample-wise τ (Sp τ ).

answer_4.quote: To evaluate how well automatic caption metrics align with human preferences, we adopt the evaluation protocol from DE-CAPBENCH. This human correlation benchmark consists of 100 images... Human-annotated ratings are available for five captions per image.
answer_4.guideline: Adopting the evaluation protocol from DE-CAPBENCH
